units.source_text: “嗯，去湖水的第二天，就突然……”列席观战的小野田六段答道。

en.t: "Yes, on the day after we went to the lake, quite suddenly..." replied Onoda, sixth dan, who was present watching the game.

units.source_text: 小野田六段刚从东京到达。

en.t: Onoda, sixth dan, had just arrived from Tokyo.

units.source_text: 所谓湖水，是指前次对局的次日，即十七日，名人、大竹七段、小野田六段等人一起到芦之湖去垂钓的事。

en.t: By "the lake," he meant the fishing trip to Lake Ashi that the Master, Otake, seventh dan, Onoda, sixth dan, and the others had taken together on the day after the previous game, that is, on the seventeenth.
